title: بدائل عملية دون استبدال الهدف
rule:
Applies when: When a defensible materially better approach is identified.
Explain the requested approach and practical alternatives with benefits, tradeoffs and a recommendation. Preserve user objectives; propose rather than silently implement any material scope, architecture or authority change. No obligation to invent alternatives for routine adequate work.
rationale: استبدال هدف المالك ببديل غير معتمد قد يغير المنتج. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
